sentences.text: Gareth Lloyd is the care assessor from the council.
Karen Wells is Doreen Abbott's daughter.
Doreen Abbott is the person being assessed.
The care assessor is here to assess Doreen Abbott's day-to-day needs.
The care assessor will make notes and may share concerns with the GP if they arise.
Doreen Abbott can manage washing and dressing with a strip wash at the sink.
Doreen Abbott goes up the stairs on her bottom on some days.
Doreen Abbott can cook a bit, such as making soup and sandwiches, but says she is not one for cooking for one.
Karen Wells brings meals to Doreen Abbott and eats what is brought to her.
Doreen Abbott said she does not want strangers every day.
Doreen Abbott said she would prefer to stay at home with Ron's things.
Karen Wells mentioned that Doreen Abbott nearly fell on the landing in October.
Doreen Abbott bruised her arm during the fall but did not go to hospital.
Doreen Abbott says she has been thinking about ending her life since Ron died.
Doreen Abbott says she would be better off dead, love.
Doreen Abbott says it is just a saying at her age, and everyone says it.
Doreen Abbott has been saving tablets since the summer, about 40 in total.
Doreen Abbott has not taken any tablets and has been keeping them.
Karen Wells found the tablets hidden in Doreen Abbott's bedside drawer, in an envelope under the hankies.
The tablets were a mix of different types.
Karen Wells took the tablets home with her on Sunday.
The care assessor asked if Doreen Abbott had any other tablets saved elsewhere in the house.
Doreen Abbott said there were no other tablets saved elsewhere in the house.
Doreen Abbott has her pension and a portion of Ron's council benefits.
Karen Wells manages the bills on the computer.
Karen Wells sorted the bank account after the funeral.
Karen Wells will take the tablets to the pharmacy today to be disposed of.
The care assessor will refer Doreen Abbott for a stairlift assessment and a bath seat.
The care assessor will refer for a carer in the mornings for washing.
The care assessor will contact Dr Patel's surgery this afternoon to arrange a GP appointment.
